title: Nemotron 3 Nano: many tasks crash in <3 seconds
description: In CRUSH + Nemotron Nano local run, 7 tasks crashed in 1-2s (both trials): collab-server, fts-search, monorepo-disaster, phantom-invoice, plugin-marketplace, task-queue, time-tracker. Scored workspace baselines, not real attempts. Check if llama.cpp connection issue (haight:8090), CRUSH startup failure, or model-rewrite hack fragility.

title: Zen meditation: ambiguity/hard regression (-8pp)
description: Meditate primitive regressed ambiguity/hard from 0.68 (v2) to 0.60 (v3). Only category where meditation made things worse. Hypothesis: ambiguous requirements need aggressive exploration, not stillness. Meditation may make the model too accepting of its first interpretation. Examine v2 vs v3 output, consider whether MIRROR or INVERSION stratagems would help.

title: Phase 10 writeup: routing results + routing feature
description: Experiment doc needs Phase 10 covering: routing benchmark results (v10-routed adapter), routing feature implementation in conclave, analysis of whether model routing improves cost/quality tradeoffs. Results in v10-routed.log, design in docs/plans/2026-03-22-v7-adaptive-routing-design.md, findings doc in docs/plans/2026-02-26-thunderdome-findings-and-roadmap.md.

title: Ralph ablation: rerun with clean data
description: The ralph ablation run was killed mid-run and never produced clean results. Need a full rerun to isolate ralph-loop's contribution to scores. Rerun across all 19 tasks with 2 trials, compare against no-review baseline (0.866 mean). v6 findings showed skill text is the primary driver (+10-12pp), consensus adds nothing measurable. Ralph-loop's contribution is unknown.

title: Gemma 4 MoE: reasoning/hard bottleneck (0.20 across all 3 tasks)
description: Gemma 4 MoE hard benchmark: overall mean 0.398. Strengths: correctness 0.84, bugfix 0.75. Weakness: reasoning/hard 0.20 uniformly across all 3 tasks. Investigate whether model is giving up, going in circles, or confidently wrong. Compare with Sonnet/Opus reasoning scores. Determine if context window, instruction following, or raw reasoning limitation.

title: Greenfield/complex task 8: persistent 0.28 on Sonnet
description: One greenfield/complex task consistently scores 0.28 across all Sonnet variants (zen v1, v2, v3). Opus breaks through to 0.79. Need to examine the task description, check output JSONL for failure patterns, determine if this is a Sonnet capability ceiling or prompt/scaffolding issue.

title: Run amplifier-nemotron-nano benchmark
description: Three harnesses created for Nemotron 3 Nano but only two ran: crush-nemotron-nano-local (0.505 mean), aider-nemotron-nano-local (0.503 mean), amplifier-nemotron-nano (never ran). Run Amplifier adapter against all 19 tasks via OpenRouter free tier. Model is likely the bottleneck (~0.50) not the harness.

title: Add more benchmark tasks for statistical power
description: Several categories have only 1 task: greenfield/simple, features/medium, bugfix/medium, marathon, recovery, features/complex, bugfix/hard, correctness/hard, ambiguity/hard. Single-task categories are noisy. Priority: greenfield/simple (variance 0.32-0.93), ambiguity/hard, marathon. Add 2-3 tasks per thin category.

title: Opus auth crashes in zen v3 benchmark
description: In zen v3 Opus run, two tasks crashed from auth/startup failures: bugfix/hard (7s, 0 tokens) and features/complex (67s). Scores came from existing workspace state. Possible causes: transient API auth failure, Docker credential mounting race condition, proxy startup timing.

title: Experiment: task-specific stratagem routing
description: Zen helps greenfield (+57pp) and reasoning (+16pp) but hurts ambiguity (-8pp). Create a routing adapter that selects stratagem based on task category: ZEN for greenfield/reasoning, MIRROR or INVERSION for ambiguity, PIVOT for bugfix. Run full benchmark to compare against uniform zen (0.856) and baseline (0.866). Depends on understanding the ambiguity regression.

title: Scoring: pre-existing workspace code inflates crash scores
description: When adapters crash early (auth failure, 2s timeout), tasks still get scored against existing workspace. Examples: Opus bugfix/hard crashed 7s but scored 0.75; CRUSH+Nano tasks crashed 1-2s but scored 0.585-0.835. Proposal: flag crash scores separately, track workspace baseline vs agent contribution. Require minimum duration/token threshold (e.g. <10s or <100 tokens = score 0.0).

title: Track cost per score point across all adapters
description: Key v6 finding: Sonnet+TDD (98.2%) beats Opus at half cost. Need systematic cost-efficiency analysis. Build report showing cost per task, score per dollar, cost-quality Pareto frontier, break-even for Opus premium. Data in .thunderdome-metrics.json (total_cost_usd) and meta.json (composite_score, total_cost_usd). Local model runs (Nemotron) are $0 API but have hardware cost.

title: Experiment: meditation on other models (Gemma 4, Nemotron)
description: Meditate primitive showed strong results on Claude. Test whether cognitive state shift transfers to other model families: Gemma 4 MoE (hard mean 0.398, weak reasoning 0.20) and Nemotron 3 Nano (~0.50 mean). Key questions: do non-Claude models respond to meditation framing? Is there a minimum capability threshold? Could simplified meditation prompt (no tool use) work for models without plugin support?

title: Marathon: Opus underperforms Sonnet (0.62 vs 0.76)
description: Zen v3 Opus scored 0.62 on marathon vs Sonnet's 0.76. Opus took 651s vs 451s. One of few categories where Opus does worse. Hypothesis: marathon rewards efficiency; Opus over-thinks, burning budget/time. Sonnet's direct approach may be an advantage. Single task category though, could be noise.

title: Document complete zen experiment results
description: Zen experiment across 4 runs is complete but undocumented. zen v1 Sonnet 0.808, v2 Sonnet 0.797, v3 Sonnet 0.856, v3 Opus 0.876. Baseline 0.866. Write full results table, per-category breakdown, analysis of where meditation helps (greenfield +57pp, reasoning +16pp) and hurts (ambiguity -8pp), v2 vs v3 comparison isolating meditate primitive, cost analysis, recommendations. Add to findings doc.
